subject: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM ops runbook for Helix Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rebecca Sims <rebecca.sims@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM ops runbook for Helix Health

Hi Sanjay —

Great to meet briefly on the call last week. Per our discussion, Redwood is ready to start the AWS co-sell enrollment and get a PDM/PSM intro in place so we can align on the Marketplace listing and the mutual action plan.

Quick context: Helix Health is evaluating Redwood for inference serving in production (low-latency clinical NLP). AWS co-sell will help with credits and GTM; PDM/PSM pairing will make the ACE intake and listing smoother.

Attachments: AWS_ACE_Checklist.xlsx (our recommended intake), Helix_Opportunity_SOW.pdf (sample SOW), MAP-Helix-2027.md (draft mutual action plan)

Would you confirm the following so we can complete the ACE registration today?
- Primary AWS contact and IAM/partner email for the ACE form
- Any procurement constraints (PO cadence, legal redline owners) we should note
- Target go-live window (you mentioned Q3 2027 on the call)

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) Fill ACE registration (this week) — action: Redwood (Aditya + Karthik) + Helix (Sanjay)
2) Intro call: PDM/PSM + Helix + Redwood — propose Fri May 1, 10:00 AM PT (30 mins)
3) Mutual action plan: finalize MAP with milestones and owners (by May 7)

If that works, Rebecca — could you confirm the PDM/PSM who will own the Helix account and any ACE intake form link we should use?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Rebecca Sims <rebecca.sims@amazon.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM ops runbook for Helix Health

Hi Aditya / Sanjay —

Thanks for the note. I’m Rebecca (AWS GTM/Partner Eng). Happy to coordinate the ACE intake. For Helix Health I’ll be the primary ACE contact and I’ll loop in our PDM (Emily Chu) and the assigned PSM (Roberto Diaz) on the intro call.

ACE intake items we typically need:
- Marketplace account email + legal entity name
- High-level SOW or solution brief (one pager)
- Customer contact for technical and procurement questions

I can start the ACE registration once you confirm the marketplace email and the one-pager. I’ve penciled Fri May 1, 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute PDM/PSM intro — that time works for Emily and Roberto.

I attached the internal intake checklist we use on the AWS side for ACE registrations and will share the Partner Central submission link in a follow-up.

Rebecca Sims
AWS Partner Programs
rebecca.sims@amazon.com

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM ops runbook for Helix Health

Thanks Aditya / Rebecca —

Appreciate the clear plan. Confirming: Helix Health is happy to move forward with the ACE registration.

Answers:
- Marketplace / billing entity: Helix Health, Inc. (marketplace-account@helixhealth.com)
- Procurement: standard 60-day net PO. Our legal lead is Priya Menon (priya.menon@helixhealth.com) — she’ll be the one to review any SOW redlines.
- Go-live: aiming for late Aug 2027 (pilot in July).

May 1, 10:00 AM PT works for the PDM/PSM intro. Could you add a 10-minute section for procurement Q&A? Priya will join that portion. Also, is there anything specific AWS needs from our security team for initial review?

Thanks — I’ve attached the draft SOW we referenced (Helix_Opportunity_SOW.pdf).

—Sanjay
VP, Platform Engineering
Helix Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-30T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM ops runbook for Helix Health — internal plan

Team — quick summary and owner map after the acceptances above.

Summary:
- ACE registration: Rebecca to submit Partner Central entry once Helix confirms marketplace email (confirmed: marketplace-account@helixhealth.com).
- PDM/PSM intro: Fri May 1, 10:00 AM PT (30 mins) — Rebecca will invite Emily Chu (PDM) and Roberto Diaz (PSM).
- Procurement: Priya Menon (Helix legal) will own SOW review; Karthik to coordinate redline expectations and provide standard Redwood procurement language.
- MAP: I created a draft MAP (MAP-Helix-2027.md) and uploaded to our shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/helix/MAP-Helix-2027.md

Action items (owners):
- Aditya: finalize ACE checklist fields and submit draft to Rebecca (today) — see AWS_ACE_Checklist.xlsx
- Karthik: prepare Redwood procurement playbook excerpt and run it by Priya post-intro (by May 5)
- Laura: prepare the Marketplace listing brief (one-pager) and the implementation timeline (by May 6)
- Rebecca (AWS): complete ACE intake and send Partner Central link / PDM/PSM invites

Next steps: I’ll host the MAP review after the intro call and convert any PDM/PSM milestones into the shared MAP. Please add any updates or blockers in the HubSpot record (HLX-2027-034).

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
